    "source_summary": "This Week 01 lecture repairs uncertain MATLAB foundations through one familiar model: a ball launched vertically upward with air resistance neglected.       "physical interpretation"

        "air resistance is neglected"

        "y0": "0 m",
        "v0": "20 m s^-1",

        "starts at y = 0 m",
        "rises to one maximum",
